modules.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Stateless application tiers keep session state __________ individual compute instances so capacity can scale out and replace instances safely.

reveal.text: Stateless application tiers keep session state outside individual compute instances so capacity can scale out and replace instances safely.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use __________ behind a load balancer when demand changes and the application can add or remove interchangeable workers.

reveal.text: Use horizontal scaling behind a load balancer when demand changes and the application can add or remove interchangeable workers.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not store irreplaceable __________ only on one EC2 instance if that instance can be terminated by Auto Scaling.

reveal.text: Do not store irreplaceable session state only on one EC2 instance if that instance can be terminated by Auto Scaling.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: An Auto Scaling web tier is easier to make resilient when sessions live in a __________ rather than local memory.

reveal.text: An Auto Scaling web tier is easier to make resilient when sessions live in a shared store rather than local memory.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
Stateless services and horizontal scaling — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Elastic Load Balancing distributes requests across __________, and EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts the number of instances to match demand.

reveal.text: Elastic Load Balancing distributes requests across healthy targets, and EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts the number of instances to match demand.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use __________ with a load balancer and Auto Scaling group for an elastic web tier that can replace unhealthy instances.

reveal.text: Use multiple Availability Zones with a load balancer and Auto Scaling group for an elastic web tier that can replace unhealthy instances.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not use a __________ instance when the requirement explicitly calls for automatic horizontal scale and instance replacement.

reveal.text: Do not use a single fixed instance when the requirement explicitly calls for automatic horizontal scale and instance replacement.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Unpredictable HTTP traffic plus automatic scale-out usually points to an __________ with an Auto Scaling group.

reveal.text: Unpredictable HTTP traffic plus automatic scale-out usually points to an ALB with an Auto Scaling group.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
Load balancing with Auto Scaling — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon SQS stores messages durably so producers and consumers can operate at __________ without a direct synchronous dependency.

reveal.text: Amazon SQS stores messages durably so producers and consumers can operate at different rates without a direct synchronous dependency.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use a queue to __________, retry failed work, and let worker fleets scale independently from request producers.

reveal.text: Use a queue to absorb bursts, retry failed work, and let worker fleets scale independently from request producers.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not require producers to __________ for every background worker to finish when asynchronous processing is acceptable.

reveal.text: Do not require producers to wait for every background worker to finish when asynchronous processing is acceptable.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A bursty producer overwhelming a slower worker tier is a classic __________ buffering scenario.

reveal.text: A bursty producer overwhelming a slower worker tier is a classic SQS buffering scenario.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
Amazon SQS decoupling — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon SNS publishes one message to __________ or downstream endpoints through a topic.

reveal.text: Amazon SNS publishes one message to multiple subscribers or downstream endpoints through a topic.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use SNS when one event must __________ to several consumers, such as SQS queues, Lambda functions, or notification endpoints.

reveal.text: Use SNS when one event must fan out to several consumers, such as SQS queues, Lambda functions, or notification endpoints.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not choose a __________ when every independent consumer must receive its own copy of each event.

reveal.text: Do not choose a single SQS queue when every independent consumer must receive its own copy of each event.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: One event delivered to multiple independent consumers points to an __________ topic, often with SQS subscriptions.

reveal.text: One event delivered to multiple independent consumers points to an SNS topic, often with SQS subscriptions.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
Amazon SNS fan-out — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon EventBridge routes events from AWS services, custom applications, and partners to targets by matching __________.

reveal.text: Amazon EventBridge routes events from AWS services, custom applications, and partners to targets by matching event patterns.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use it when consumers should react to __________ without tight coupling to the event producer.

reveal.text: Use it when consumers should react to selected events without tight coupling to the event producer.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not use EventBridge as block storage or as a substitute for a durable __________ that needs explicit consumer polling semantics.

reveal.text: Do not use EventBridge as block storage or as a substitute for a durable work queue that needs explicit consumer polling semantics.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Rule-based routing of AWS service events to Lambda, Step Functions, or other targets points to __________.

reveal.text: Rule-based routing of AWS service events to Lambda, Step Functions, or other targets points to EventBridge.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
Amazon EventBridge routing — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS Step Functions coordinates multi-step workflows with explicit states, __________, retries, timeouts, and service integrations.

reveal.text: AWS Step Functions coordinates multi-step workflows with explicit states, branching, retries, timeouts, and service integrations.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use it when a business process needs __________ across multiple Lambda functions or AWS services.

reveal.text: Use it when a business process needs durable orchestration across multiple Lambda functions or AWS services.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not embed a long and failure-prone orchestration state machine entirely inside __________ invocation when Step Functions fits the workflow.

reveal.text: Do not embed a long and failure-prone orchestration state machine entirely inside one Lambda invocation when Step Functions fits the workflow.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A visual workflow with retries, branches, and several service calls points to __________.

reveal.text: A visual workflow with retries, branches, and several service calls points to Step Functions.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
AWS Step Functions — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS Lambda runs event-driven code __________ and scales concurrent execution in response to incoming work within service limits.

reveal.text: AWS Lambda runs event-driven code without managing servers and scales concurrent execution in response to incoming work within service limits.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use Lambda for __________ event handlers, APIs, stream processing, and automation when server management is unnecessary.

reveal.text: Use Lambda for short-lived event handlers, APIs, stream processing, and automation when server management is unnecessary.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not choose Lambda for a single invocation that must run longer than the service's __________ execution duration.

reveal.text: Do not choose Lambda for a single invocation that must run longer than the service's maximum execution duration.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Event-driven code with unpredictable traffic and minimal infrastructure management is a __________ clue.

reveal.text: Event-driven code with unpredictable traffic and minimal infrastructure management is a Lambda clue.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
Lambda serverless compute — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS __________, while AWS Fargate supplies serverless container compute for supported ECS and EKS workloads.

reveal.text: Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS orchestrate containers, while AWS Fargate supplies serverless container compute for supported ECS and EKS workloads.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use ECS when AWS-native container orchestration fits, EKS when __________ compatibility is required, and Fargate when you want to avoid managing worker nodes.

reveal.text: Use ECS when AWS-native container orchestration fits, EKS when Kubernetes compatibility is required, and Fargate when you want to avoid managing worker nodes.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not select EKS __________ because containers are present if the workload does not require Kubernetes APIs or ecosystem compatibility.

reveal.text: Do not select EKS solely because containers are present if the workload does not require Kubernetes APIs or ecosystem compatibility.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Kubernetes requirement points to __________; containers without node management can point to Fargate.

reveal.text: Kubernetes requirement points to EKS; containers without node management can point to Fargate.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
ECS, EKS, and Fargate — AWS documentation

nodes.title: API Gateway for loosely coupled APIs

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon API Gateway provides __________ for REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs and integrates with backends such as Lambda or private services.

reveal.text: Amazon API Gateway provides managed endpoints for REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs and integrates with backends such as Lambda or private services.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use it to expose managed APIs with features such as authentication integration, __________, stages, and request routing.

reveal.text: Use it to expose managed APIs with features such as authentication integration, throttling, stages, and request routing.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not deploy and operate __________ only to obtain standard managed API-front-door capabilities.

reveal.text: Do not deploy and operate custom proxy servers only to obtain standard managed API-front-door capabilities.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A serverless REST API in front of Lambda with throttling requirements points to __________.

reveal.text: A serverless REST API in front of Lambda with throttling requirements points to API Gateway.

source_refs.title: Design scalable and loosely coupled architectures — official exam guide
API Gateway for loosely coupled APIs — AWS documentation

modules.title: Design highly available and/or fault-tolerant architectures

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: RDS Multi-AZ deployments primarily improve __________ with failover, while read replicas primarily scale read traffic and can support some disaster-recovery patterns.

reveal.text: RDS Multi-AZ deployments primarily improve availability with failover, while read replicas primarily scale read traffic and can support some disaster-recovery patterns.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use Multi-AZ when the main requirement is database availability, and add read replicas when __________ must scale independently.

reveal.text: Use Multi-AZ when the main requirement is database availability, and add read replicas when read throughput must scale independently.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not choose a read replica as the direct __________ for a Multi-AZ standby when automatic high-availability failover is the requirement.

reveal.text: Do not choose a read replica as the direct substitute for a Multi-AZ standby when automatic high-availability failover is the requirement.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: High availability points to __________; read scaling points to read replicas.

reveal.text: High availability points to Multi-AZ; read scaling points to read replicas.

source_refs.title: Design highly available and/or fault-tolerant architectures — official exam guide
RDS Multi-AZ vs read replicas — AWS documentation

nodes.title: Availability Zones and Regions as failure domains

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Availability Zones are __________ within a Region, and using multiple AZs reduces exposure to a single-AZ failure.

reveal.text: Availability Zones are isolated locations within a Region, and using multiple AZs reduces exposure to a single-AZ failure.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use multiple AZs for high availability inside a Region and __________ when business requirements demand regional disaster recovery or locality.

reveal.text: Use multiple AZs for high availability inside a Region and multiple Regions when business requirements demand regional disaster recovery or locality.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not place every redundant component in __________ and call the architecture highly available across AZ failures.

reveal.text: Do not place every redundant component in one Availability Zone and call the architecture highly available across AZ failures.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: An AZ-outage requirement means redundant components must span more than one Availability __________.

reveal.text: An AZ-outage requirement means redundant components must span more than one Availability Zone.

source_refs.title: Design highly available and/or fault-tolerant architectures — official exam guide
Availability Zones and Regions as failure domains — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon Route 53 __________ can direct users among endpoints, and health-aware policies can stop returning unhealthy targets when configured appropriately.

reveal.text: Amazon Route 53 routing policies can direct users among endpoints, and health-aware policies can stop returning unhealthy targets when configured appropriately.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use __________ for active-passive patterns and latency-based routing when users should be sent to a low-latency healthy Region.

reveal.text: Use failover routing for active-passive patterns and latency-based routing when users should be sent to a low-latency healthy Region.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not expect DNS failover to preserve __________ that already reached a failed endpoint.

reveal.text: Do not expect DNS failover to preserve in-flight connections that already reached a failed endpoint.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: DNS-level active-passive failover between endpoints points to __________ failover routing with health evaluation.

reveal.text: DNS-level active-passive failover between endpoints points to Route 53 failover routing with health evaluation.

source_refs.title: Design highly available and/or fault-tolerant architectures — official exam guide
Route 53 health checks and failover — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, and multi-site __________ trade cost and complexity for progressively faster recovery.

reveal.text: Backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, and multi-site active-active trade cost and complexity for progressively faster recovery.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Select a disaster-recovery strategy from business __________ requirements rather than choosing the most complex pattern by default.

reveal.text: Select a disaster-recovery strategy from business RPO and RTO requirements rather than choosing the most complex pattern by default.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not use a __________ backup-and-restore design when the required recovery time is shorter than restoring infrastructure and data can achieve.

reveal.text: Do not use a slow backup-and-restore design when the required recovery time is shorter than restoring infrastructure and data can achieve.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Very low RTO and RPO requirements usually require continuously __________ rather than backups alone.

reveal.text: Very low RTO and RPO requirements usually require continuously running capacity rather than backups alone.

source_refs.title: Design highly available and/or fault-tolerant architectures — official exam guide
Disaster recovery strategies and RPO/RTO — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Replication improves availability or locality by maintaining additional copies, while backups preserve recoverable __________.

reveal.text: Replication improves availability or locality by maintaining additional copies, while backups preserve recoverable historical points.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use both when the workload needs __________ plus protection from accidental deletion, corruption, or application mistakes.

reveal.text: Use both when the workload needs rapid failover plus protection from accidental deletion, corruption, or application mistakes.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not assume __________ protects against logical corruption because bad changes can replicate to additional copies.

reveal.text: Do not assume replication alone protects against logical corruption because bad changes can replicate to additional copies.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A design needing low RPO plus recovery from accidental deletion often combines __________ with versioned backups.

reveal.text: A design needing low RPO plus recovery from accidental deletion often combines replication with versioned backups.

source_refs.title: Design highly available and/or fault-tolerant architectures — official exam guide
Replication, backups, and durability — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon RDS Proxy __________ and shares database connections so large numbers of application connections do not overwhelm an RDS or Aurora database.

reveal.text: Amazon RDS Proxy pools and shares database connections so large numbers of application connections do not overwhelm an RDS or Aurora database.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use it for bursty serverless or microservice workloads that create many __________ database connections.

reveal.text: Use it for bursty serverless or microservice workloads that create many short-lived database connections.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not add __________ solely to solve connection storms when the main bottleneck is connection establishment and pooling.

reveal.text: Do not add read replicas solely to solve connection storms when the main bottleneck is connection establishment and pooling.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Many Lambda functions exhausting database connections points to __________.

reveal.text: Many Lambda functions exhausting database connections points to RDS Proxy.

source_refs.title: Design highly available and/or fault-tolerant architectures — official exam guide
RDS Proxy and connection resilience — AWS documentation

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Immutable infrastructure __________ unhealthy or outdated instances from versioned images or templates instead of manually repairing servers in place.

reveal.text: Immutable infrastructure replaces unhealthy or outdated instances from versioned images or templates instead of manually repairing servers in place.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use launch templates, images, Auto Scaling, and infrastructure as code to make replacement predictable and __________.

reveal.text: Use launch templates, images, Auto Scaling, and infrastructure as code to make replacement predictable and repeatable.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Do not rely on unique __________ servers that cannot be recreated after failure.

reveal.text: Do not rely on unique hand-configured servers that cannot be recreated after failure.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: A requirement to rebuild identical capacity automatically from a known configuration points to __________ infrastructure.

reveal.text: A requirement to rebuild identical capacity automatically from a known configuration points to immutable infrastructure.

source_refs.title: Design highly available and/or fault-tolerant architectures — official exam guide
Immutable infrastructure and automated replacement — AWS documentation
